title: Sedona, Jerome and Montezuma Castle Day Tour From Phoenix
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Leave the city behind and journey into the heart of Northern Arizona's rich history, stunning landscapes, and quirky charm on this ultimate one-day van tour from Phoenix. Designed to maximize your time without the hassle of driving, this curated itinerary effortlessly blends ancient Native American culture, a historic ghost town, and the world-famous red rocks of Sedona.

Your day begins at Montezuma Castle National Monument, where you'll marvel at a remarkably preserved 800-year-old cliff dwelling carved into a limestone cliff. Next, wind up the mountain to Jerome, once proclaimed the "Wickedest Town in the West" — today a bustling hillside artist community of eccentric shops, fascinating history, and panoramic valley views.

The adventure wraps up in breathtaking Sedona, surrounded by towering crimson red rocks, vibrant boutiques, and local eateries of Uptown Sedona. The perfect blend of ancient history, culture, and scenery before a relaxing drive back to Phoenix.
